name: genpark-multi-agent-byzantine-fault-tolerant-voting-arbiter-skill
description: Multi-Agent Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) Quorum Voting Arbiter. Enforces 3f+1 Byzantine resilience across heterogeneous LLM verifier agents, filters hallucinating or adversarial outlier nodes using reputation-weighted supermajority (2f+1) quorum rules, and issues cryptographically signed consensus certificates.

tools.name: arbitrate_bft_agent_quorum
tools.description: Evaluate multi-agent votes under 3f+1 Byzantine Fault Tolerance, isolate hallucinating/adversarial agents, and issue a signed quorum certificate.

votes.description: List of agent votes [agent_id, decision, confidence, reputation_weight].
